title: adr-feature
description: Proposal root for durable architecture decision record generation after validated Cartographer work.

verification.validation: curated root; validate-topic checks graph syntax and endpoints

title: selected ADR decision-record folder
description: Proposed durable documentation folder containing chronological standalone ADR Markdown files committed with the repository; use an existing ADR/decisions convention when present, otherwise docs/adr.

title: selected ADR _graph folder
description: Proposed JSONL graph subfolder under the selected ADR directory containing ADR nodes and relationships such as supersedes, depends_on, refines, and related_to.

title: ADR Markdown template
description: Proposed template for generated standalone decision records with searchable metadata and low-staleness body sections.

title: cartographer_adr standalone tool
description: Proposed dedicated user-facing CLI/extension tool for ADR creation, lookup, relationship management, validation, imports, and workflow-generated ADR finalization outside or inside the full Cartographer workflow.

title: Pi Cartographer README
description: Documents current package resources, artifacts, clean context, helper CLIs, limitations, and current note that ADR generation is out of scope.

title: Proposal workflow skill
description: Defines proposal artifact generation and currently treats final ADR generation into docs as future work.

title: Plan workflow skill
description: Defines plan graph artifacts and currently treats final ADR generation into docs as future work.

title: Implement workflow skill
description: Owns phase completion, validation receipts, commits, and final handoff; proposed ADR generation should hook after validated completion.

title: Index project skill
description: Documents code/plans/all retrieval scopes and index behavior that should include durable docs ADRs while excluding raw private artifacts.

title: Project indexer
description: Builds and queries the SQLite/FTS project graph; proposed ADR docs and graph records should become searchable without indexing raw private artifacts.

title: JSONL artifact manager
description: Validates and upserts JSONL planning artifacts; proposed ADR graph validation can follow this pattern.

title: Planning graph validator
description: Validates graph relationships, file references, sensitive evidence constraints, and lifecycle state; proposed ADR graph validator can reuse this validation style.

title: Validation runner
description: Runs deterministic workflow checks and records concise receipts; proposed ADR generation should require successful validation evidence.

title: Cartographer Pi tools extension
description: Exposes Cartographer tools; proposed ADR work should add a dedicated shaped cartographer_adr tool rather than burying ADR domain behavior under cartographer_jsonl.

title: Planning graph tests
description: Tests deterministic planning graph validation using temporary mock repositories; ADR graph validation should follow the same temporary-artifact rule.

title: JSONL manager tests
description: Tests TypeScript JSONL validation and upsert behavior; ADR node/edge schema validation should add analogous tests.
